comments.content: `toLSPDiagnostic` is called with `nil` converters here, but the function dereferences `converters` (e.g. `converters.RuneConverter`/`converters.PositionEncoding`). This will panic at runtime. Pass `l.converters` through to `toLSPDiagnostics` instead of hardcoding `nil`.

The `Kind: lsproto.StringLiteralFull{}` field was dropped from the `FullDocumentDiagnosticReport`. If this field is required by the LSP spec/consumers, omitting it changes the response shape. Confirm this is intentional or restore it.
